memories.content:
Next.js MDX Portfolio Architecture:
- Next.js 14 with App Router
- MDX content management via gray-matter + next-mdx-remote
- File-based routing: posts/ and projects/ directories
- Content located in content/posts/*.mdx and content/projects/*.mdx
- Email integration via Resend API for contact forms and newsletter
- Styling: Tailwind CSS with CSS variables and dark mode support
- Form validation: react-hook-form + zod schemas
- Key libraries: next-themes, react-hook-form, zod, gray-matter, next-mdx-remote, resend, sugar-high
- TypeScript throughout with strict typing
